slides.title: Why Is Cleaning Necessary?
bullets: Bacterial plaque forms on the tooth surface every day
Removing it regularly reduces the risk of caries and gingival inflammation
slides.caption: Healthy tooth

slides.title: Toothbrushing
bullets: Twice a day with fluoride toothpaste
Clean all surfaces: lip and cheek sides, tongue side and chewing surfaces
Allow enough time for brushing; do not rush
Replace the toothbrush when it becomes worn

slides.title: Focus on the Chewing Surface
bullets: Direct the toothbrush bristles into the grooves
Clean the back teeth thoroughly as well
slides.caption: Chewing surface with grooves

slides.title: Interdental Cleaning and Check-ups
bullets: Clean between the teeth with dental floss or interdental brushes
Gently clean the coating on the tongue
Attend preventive check-ups at the intervals recommended by a dentist

slides.title: Key Points
bullets: Do not forget the spaces between the teeth

quiz.q: What forms on the tooth surface every day?
quiz.explanation: Bacterial plaque must be removed regularly.

quiz.q: How often is toothbrushing usually recommended?
quiz.explanation: Twice a day with fluoride toothpaste.

quiz.q: How are the spaces between the teeth cleaned?
options: With dental floss or an interdental brush
quiz.explanation: A toothbrush does not reach between the teeth.

options: The grooves of the chewing surface
quiz.explanation: Plaque can accumulate in the grooves.

quiz.q: What determines when to have a preventive check-up?
quiz.explanation: The interval is set according to the dentist’s recommendation.
